parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more tightly personalized rationales tied to specific profile attributes (loss comfort, sequence-of-returns risk, net worth math) and stays grounded in the given portfolio, whereas System B introduces unsupported claims (assumed 401(k) under-contribution, invented current yield ~1.8%) and one recommendation (catch-up contributions) that fabricates facts not in the profile. Both are comparably actionable and diversification-aware, but A's calibrated language and stronger factual grounding give it the overall edge.
